text:
diane: Heads-up: Finance surfaced a request — quota dashboards show large "leaked" usage for pooled projects when SAs get routed. Customers see spike in billed project and open tickets. Can we tighten telemetry so console and billing align?

harry: Yup. Current flow: pre-routing header used for UI, post-routing project used for billing. We need a single source of truth emitted at routing decision time.

sophia: Proposal: emit a compact metric `auth.routing.effective_count{org,quota_project,reason}` and a sampled event `auth.routing.effective_event` containing short fields + `routing_hash`. Events only for sampled traces to keep cardinality low.

yusuf: Important: we already have ratebanding by project; if we start tagging metrics with quota_project it could be high-cardinality. Suggest metric tags: reason,is_fallback and an aggregated `billed_pool` boolean. Detailed events map to routing_hash.

diane: UX ask: Console should show two labels — "Billed project" (computed from effective routing) and "Requester SA". Add small "why" link explaining pooled billing. Tile behind flag `ui.auth.routing_effective.v1`.

harry: Implementation sketch:
- router: compute effective_project and a short `routing_hash` (e.g., 8-char base32) deterministically for the request window. Attach to request context.
- metrics: increment `auth.routing.count{reason,is_fallback}` and `auth.routing.billed_pool_total` (aggregated boolean).
- events: sampled POST to telemetry: `requested_sa`, `effective_project`, `reason`, `routing_hash`, `ts`. Keep ids short, no emails.

sophia: sampling plan: default 0.2% global, 100% for SRE/CS orgs and any org with open ticket. For customers on Dedicated/Private default to `aggregated` mode; provide config `telemetry.routing_mode=aggregated|detailed`.

yusuf: Alerting: soft alert when fallback_rate(org,30m) > 0.3% -> notify triage; page when >1% for 1h. Use metrics only so sampling doesn't affect triggers.

diane: Security: private control planes must not send project ids upstream. If `telemetry.routing_mode=detailed` in private, events go to customer sink only. Our SaaS will respect data residency flags.

harry: Console drill: clicking "Billed project" opens a drilldown by `routing_hash` + time range. The shared URL does not contain project id to avoid leaking tenant info.

sophia: Also add a small per-route dashboard: fraction of requests routed to pools, average token cost delta when pool used, and top orgs by fallback rate. Helps prioritize pinned capacity sales.

yusuf: Good call. We can compute token cost delta by correlating `auth.routing.billed_pool_total` with per-route `token_cost` metrics. Will add SLO card.

deploy-bot: router-canary-8 deploy queued. CI: green.

harry: PRs I'll open: (1) router change + routing_hash generation, (2) metrics emission, (3) telemetry pipeline sampled sink + retention 30d, (4) console UI tile + drilldown mock. Tagging @sophia @diane.

diane: Also short CS blurb: 1-paragraph explaining pooled billing, how to read the console card, and steps to request pinned capacity. Can someone draft?

sophia: I'll draft tooltip and CS blurb. Will post to #customer-success once PRs land.

yusuf: Quick note: ensure routing_hash is stable for at least 5 minutes so console queries can find the event even with ingestion lag.

diane: Great. If we can review fast we can land in canary tonight and start ramping 5% -> 25% -> full. :thumbsup:
